svg.title: STC-07 · Build. Insight. Re-sort. Rank.
svg.desc: The four-part data story used in every Stagehand reel data beat, shown on six sample values: the bars build, an average line of 68.5 draws and a callout names the leader (N4 at 91, 7 ahead of N2 and 22.5 above average), the bars re-sort into rank order, and rank labels arrive. A 9.5 second timeline and the rules for each phase sit to the right.
svg.text: REF STC V1.0 / REEL V5 · FIG STC-07
Every data beat in the reel tells the same four-part story, in its own theme's language.
SAMPLE DATA · SIX SOURCES · N4 LEADS
Bars rise with a slight overshoot, 0.12 s apart, and the values count up.
The average line draws, the leader stays lit, the rest dim to half, and a callout names the gap.
Bars glide into rank order: a 1.3 s ease in and out, 0.09 s apart.
Rank labels arrive, the chart holds, then it exits on the beat.
Gap brackets (TX-04, TX-11) · limit lines (TX-08) · a log-to-linear scale morph (TX-12) · a share fold
BHIL · STAGEHAND THEME CODEX · FIG STC-07
